description:
Objective: New user receives a welcome email containing their name.
Preconditions: Open User lifecycle emails with the configured test data.

2. New user receives a welcome email containing their name.
3. Observe the resulting state.
Expected: Creating a new user in User Management must trigger a USER_CREATED welcome email delivered to the new user's address in the configured app.
